reception: The citing literature treats the paper mainly as a reference point: most citations are passing mentions in the related work of race and deadlock detectors, and surveys of testing for concurrent software list it among the static approaches. The engaged minority comes from successors in static deadlock detection — Naik, Park, and Sen position their detector against the lock-order-graph analysis — and one study reused its library subjects to compare the cost-effectiveness of static analysis and model checking for finding deadlocks. Few works build on the analysis itself; the paper settled into related-work sections as the treatment of deadlock freedom at the library interface.
